versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides a standardized workflow for generating general industry FTO (Freedom to Operate) reports using PatSnap APIs and risk-point Word documents.

- Transforms user-supplied risk-point Word files and PatSnap search queries into traceable FTO reports.
- Strictly enforces all patent search, retrieval, and AI07 analysis within internal scripts; no external or manual API calls allowed.
- Requires at least one direct PatSnap search query from the user; does not modify or generate queries automatically.
- Extracts technical features, product data, and search metadata from input documents for precise report scope and structure.
- Integrates PatSnap P002 (search), P018 (claim 1 retrieval), and AI07 (infringement comparison) via built-in utilities; document all data flows and outputs.
- Outputs structured, analyst-ready reports referencing supplied templates and business rules, with full input-to-report traceability.
